"(a) For issuance of appropriate writ/writs, order/orders, direction/directions or a writ in the nature of mandamus commanding upon the respondents specially respondent no. 2 to show cause as to how and under what authority the concerned respondent has not issued attested copy of Statement VI with regard to landed property of the petitioner admeasuring 3 acres under Mauza Saradhu having Khata no. 278 under Thana no. 29 having plot nos. 436, 699 and 719.
(b) For issuance of appropriate writ/ writs, order/ orders, direction/ directions or a writ in the nature of mandamus commanding upon the respondent no. 2 to forthwith issue attested copy of Statement VI with regard to landed property of the petitioner admeasuring 3 acres under Mauza Saradhu having Khata no. 278 under Thana no. 29 having plot nos. 436, 699 and 719.
3.

The description of land is as follows:-
4. "Land situated at Mauza Saradhu, Khata No.278, Thana No.29 having Plot Nos.436, 699 & 719 within Chatra District"
5.

The land in question has been acquired by the CCL under the Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition &
Development) Act, 1957.
6. It appears that the CCL authorities are ready to pay the amount as determined under the law.

The only dispute is "whether it is government land or private land"?
7.
Admittedly, there is existing mutation in the name of the petitioner.
Thus, there is no dispute so far as nature of raiyati land is concerned by the State.
8. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that a person who is in possession of the land for more than 30 years has a right to receive the compensation as per raiyati land.
9. In the present case, there is existing mutation in favour of the petitioner and his predecessor for last more than 30 years i.e. since 1942.
10. In that view of the matter, there is no dispute.
The CCL authorities are directed to release the amount in favour of the petitioner.
11. With above observation and direction, the present writ petition stands disposed of.
12. Pending I.A., if any, also stands disposed of.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Shahid- Uploaded Ram Kumar Bansal vs The State Of Jharkhand Through The ... on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106775730/
